description: Crypto options positioning (Deribit) for one underlying: total call/put open interest in coins and USD notional, put/call OI and volume ratios, largest strike concentrations, upcoming expirations with expiring notional and theoretical max pain, OI change over 24h/7d (from hourly snapshots), and recent trade flow (aggressor premium by calls/puts, block share, largest trades). Descriptive positioning — not a direction signal.

expiries.description: Upcoming expirations to list, default 6, max 20.

trades_hours.description: Trade-flow window in hours, default 4, max 24; 0 skips trades.
